source.quote: Net revenues from our top ten customers, including The Boeing Company ("Boeing"), General Dynamics Corporation ("GD"), Lockheed Martin Corporation ("Lockheed"), Northrop Grumman Corporation ("Northrop"), RTX Corporation ("RTX")

relations.text_en: Delivers defense propulsion technology to General Dynamics Applied Physical Sciences under a DARPA program subcontract

source.label: BETA Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As an example, we have a subcontract with General Dynamics Applied Physical Sciences, manufacturing and delivering defense propulsion technologies and associated engineering services in support of a DARPA program focused on developing advanced propulsion for undersea vehicles.

source.label: CAE 年次情報書(2026年3月期)
source.label_en: CAE Annual Information Form (FY ended Mar 2026)
source.quote: On May 30, 2023, we announced the award of a contract from General Dynamics Information Technology to support Flight School Training Support Services at Fort Novosel (formerly Fort Rucker), Alabama.

relations.text: 元請けのGDミッション・システムズと実証・研究の契約を持つ
relations.text_en: Has contracts with prime contractor General Dynamics Mission Systems for demonstrations and studies

source.label: Telesat 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: We also have contracts in place with prime contractors L3 Harris and General Dynamics Mission Systems for demonstrations and studies with Air Force Research Labs and NASA.

relations.text: GD傘下のエレクトリック・ボートと組み、バージニア級原潜を建造
relations.text_en: Builds Virginia-class submarines under a teaming agreement with GD's Electric Boat

source.label: HII 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have a teaming agreement with Electric Boat Corporation ("Electric Boat"), a division of General Dynamics Corporation ("General Dynamics"), to build Virginia class (SSN 774) fast attack nuclear submarines.

relations.text: 造船事業では主にGDと競合すると記載
relations.text_en: Says its shipbuilding segments compete primarily with General Dynamics

source.quote: Our Newport News and Ingalls segments compete primarily with General Dynamics and, in the case of certain non-nuclear shipbuilding programs, smaller shipyards.

companies.name: ロッキード・マーチン

relations.text: 固体ロケットモーターの生産でGDと戦略的チーム契約
relations.text_en: Strategic teaming agreement with General Dynamics to produce solid rocket motors

source.label: Lockheed Martin 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: such as our recently announced strategic teaming agreement with General Dynamics to produce solid rocket motors, enhancing security and resilience in a critical domestic supply chain.

source.quote: BDS faces strong competition primarily from General Dynamics Corporation, Lockheed Martin Corporation, Northrop Grumman Corporation, RTX Corporation and SpaceX.
